newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil deputies approve two reform bill amendments.
newsitem.headline: Brazil deputies approve two reform bill amendments.

text.p: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies approved two amendments to a civil service reform bill Wednesday but left amendments on sensitive points for another date, officials said.
More than 100 amendments to the bill have been presented by opposition and government lawmakers.

The government angered many members of the lower house earlier this week when it withdrew its support from a controversial amendment which would have exempted lawmakers from a proposed 10,800 reais ($10,118) ceiling on pay and pension.
The government supported the two amendments approved earlier. Voting on the other proposals is due to resume next week.
